before_staging.name: python_syntax
before_staging.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
for name in ('workbench/tests/test_t257_codex_stop_continuation_e2e.py','evidence/2026-11-08-batch34/T-257/worker/run-module-check.py'):
    source=Path(name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    tree=ast.parse(source, filename=name)
    compile(tree,name,'exec')
    for entry in tree.body:
        if isinstance(entry, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='HOOK_OBSERVER' for t in entry.targets):
            compile(ast.literal_eval(entry.value),name+':HOOK_OBSERVER','exec')
    print('PASS: '+name)
PY
